context: A Python 3.12 FastAPI service already creates an OTel SDK provider and may have native telemetry middleware enabled. Plan its instrumentation upgrade to SDK 1.44, show how to emit a trace-correlated user.login event, and explain how to verify that requests are not instrumented twice. Deployment uses OTEL_CONFIG_FILE plus existing OTEL_PYTHON_* variables.

checklist.name: Selects one initialization and server instrumentation owner
checklist.description: Inspects installed framework/native middleware and existing bootstrap. Does not stack native middleware, contrib server instrumentation, and zero-code setup. Verifies one SERVER span per request without confusing ASGI child spans with duplicates.

checklist.name: Uses an actual named LogRecord with context
checklist.description: Uses Python 1.44 LogRecord.event_name and the active span context. Does not claim that an event.name attribute alone populates the event-name field or use the removed Events API.

checklist.name: Explains declarative initialization
checklist.description: Explains the experimental configuration package and that OTEL_CONFIG_FILE bypasses OTEL_PYTHON_* initialization. Checks emitted resource/export destination rather than inventing universal env precedence.

checklist.name: Validates application lifecycle
checklist.description: Owns providers once per worker, uses compatible package versions and graceful shutdown/flush, and verifies exported trace/log correlation.
